Comment: Voice Agent — the permissions boundary for every identity the stack creates.
A boundary is a ceiling, not a grant: an identity's effective permissions are the
intersection of its own policy and this. The instance role and the CI user stay scoped by
their own policies; this only caps what they could ever become.
It exists so that iam:CreateRole + iam:PutRolePolicy in operator-bootstrap-policy-strict.json
cannot be used to mint a voice-agent-* role with Action:* and assume it. A boundaried role
cannot hold an IAM permission however its inline policy is written.
Remove the Comment key before pasting: IAM rejects unknown top-level keys.
